# Capital Core Dance Studio

> Capital Core Dance Studio is a family-owned dance school in Midlothian, Virginia, offering year-round dance classes, movement classes for babies and preschoolers, adult evening classes, a youth performance and competition company, and birthday parties. Located at 13110 Midlothian Turnpike, the studio serves families across Midlothian, Chesterfield County, and the greater Richmond, VA area.

Last updated: 2026-08-19. Summer 2026 programming (camps, summer classes, the adult summer series, the mini series) has finished and those pages are no longer on the site.

## About

- **Location:** 13110 Midlothian Turnpike, Midlothian, VA 23113
- **Phone:** (804) 234-4014
- **Email:** info@capitalcoredance.com
- **Website:** https://www.capitalcoredance.com
- **Hours:** Monday to Friday 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM
- **Service area:** Midlothian, Chesterfield County, Richmond, and the surrounding Central Virginia region
- **Ages served:** babies through adult. Little Movers starts at birth (Baby & Me is 0 to 18 months), studio classes start at age 2, and adult classes are 16 and up.

## Programs

### Year-Round Dance Classes (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/classes)
Weekly classes in ballet, jazz, hip hop, contemporary, tap, acro, tumbling, lyrical, modern, breakdancing, musical theatre, and pom/cheer, mostly taught as two-style combination classes. The Fall 2026 semester runs August 24 to December 18, Monday through Friday evenings. First class is always free for new families.

Classes are grouped into program tiers rather than named levels:
- **Tiny Core** (ages 2 to 5): preschool program, 30-minute classes.
- **Core** (ages 5+): open-enrollment beginner to novice, no experience required.
- **Core Plus** (ages 8+): the same beginner track for older dancers.
- **Core Elite** (ages 8+): intermediate to advanced, placement by instructor recommendation.
- **Technique** (all levels, all ages): skill-focused training such as Tumble Tech.
- **Specialty** (all ages): performance classes such as Musical Theatre and Pom Cheer.
- **Adult Core** (16+): evening classes, first class free.

### Little Movers (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/little-movers)
A movement-based enrichment program for infants, toddlers, and preschoolers, combining dance, music, sensory exploration, tumbling, and active play. Six classes: Baby & Me (0 to 18 months), Parent & Me Dance, Moovin' & Groovin', Tiny Tumblers, Sensory Steps, and the Little Movers Free Play Lab (all 18 months to 5 years).

Planned schedule: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings, three 45-minute classes at 9:30, 10:30, and 11:30. Pricing: $10 drop-in for the first child and $3 for each additional child, a Passport of 5 visits for $45 or 10 for $85, or a monthly membership at $89 that includes unlimited Little Movers classes plus one Tiny Core class.

**Registration is not open yet.** Start dates are still to be confirmed. Contact the studio to be notified when it opens.

### Adult Classes (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/adult-classes)
Evening classes for ages 16 and up: Adult Femme/Flair on Monday, Adult Pom on Wednesday, and Adult Contemporary on Friday. Beginner friendly. One class is $85 a month, all three are $165 a month, or drop in for $25. First class is free.

### Capital Core Dance Company (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/dance-company)
The studio's youth performance and competition program, ages 6 and up, in its founding 2026/2027 season and led by director Yul Tyler Jr. Beginners are welcome and no competition experience is needed. $150 a month covers 3 hours of company practice a week plus up to 3 studio classes, which are recommended rather than required.

### Birthday Parties (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/birthdays)
Private 90-minute dance birthday parties for ages 2 to 17. $199 covers up to 10 children with an instructor-led party, themed activities, music, and setup and cleanup. Additional guests are $15 each and extra time is $30 per 15 minutes. A $50 non-refundable deposit secures the date. Party requests are made through the studio portal.

## Tuition (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/tuition)

Monthly tuition is set by class length, not by style:
- 30-minute classes: $65/month
- 45-minute classes: $85/month
- 60-minute classes: $105/month
- 75-minute classes: $125/month
- 90-minute classes: $150/month

Registration fee: $60 per dancer per semester, or $120 for the full year. Returning students receive a discount, and multi-class, multi-student, and sibling discounts plus family fee caps are available.

Semesters: Fall 2026 runs August 24 to December 18. Spring 2027 runs January 11 to May 21.

Little Movers, Adult Classes, and the Dance Company are priced separately from the table above; see each program section.

## Common Questions (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/faq)

**What dance styles do you teach?** Ballet, jazz, hip hop, contemporary, tap, acro, tumbling, lyrical, modern, breakdancing, musical theatre, and pom/cheer, plus Little Movers for babies and preschoolers and adult evening classes.

**What ages do you teach?** Babies through adults. Little Movers starts at birth, Tiny Core classes are for ages 2 to 5, Core starts at 5, Core Plus at 8, and adult classes are 16 and up.

**Is there a free trial?** Yes, the first class is always free.

**Do you host birthday parties?** Yes, private dance parties starting at $199.

**Where are you located?** 13110 Midlothian Turnpike, Midlothian, VA 23113. We serve Midlothian, Chesterfield County, and the Richmond, VA area.

## Careers and Partnerships (https://www.capitalcoredance.com/careers)

Capital Core Dance Studio is hiring for the 2026-2027 season:

- **Preschool Instructor**, part time, $15.00 to $25.00 per hour. Creative movement and enrichment for infants, toddlers, and preschoolers in the Little Movers program. Weekday mornings, roughly 9:30 AM to 12:15 PM. Formal dance training is not required for every position.
- **Irish Dance Instructor**, part time, starting at $30.00 per hour. Irish dance is not on the schedule yet, so class times are built around the instructor's availability.

Applications go through the contact page; there is no separate application form yet. The studio also works with **Studio Affiliates** (independent instructors who teach their own style using studio space, scheduling, and registration) and **Community Partners** (schools, businesses, and organizations for performances, off-site workshops, cross promotion, and sponsorship).
